description: Get the three copy-paste badge embed snippets for a toolfound listing ('live on toolfound', 'verified', 'top 3 this week' variants). Badges are optional and earned — they deep-link to the listing with varied anchor text, and the embedder chooses the rel attribute freely. Listing status is never conditioned on embedding a badge.

slug.description: Slug of the listing to get badges for.

name: toolfound_get_badge
title: Get embed badges
